findings.claim: Across the full observed score window [0.0,0.49], the two probed landmarks show non-monotone, sign-changing displacement profiles rather than a stationary target: landmark_00_local_dx has 6 sign changes and 9 strong sign conflicts, landmark_00_local_dy has 6 sign changes and 4 strong sign conflicts, and landmark_10_local_dy has 7 sign changes with 3 strong sign conflicts.

Whole-window mean z-scores for the probed displacement coordinates are small relative to their within-window excursions (e.g. landmark_00_local_dx whole_window_z=-0.18 with values_z ranging from about -1.42 to +0.85; landmark_00_local_dy whole_window_z=-0.30), so a single whole-window average does not summarize the observed temporal contrast.

Endpoint rate diagnostics are large and opposite in sign at the two ends of the window for several probed features (landmark_00_local_dx first_rate_z=-17.5 vs last_rate_z=+8.1; landmark_00_local_dy first_rate_z=-72.4 vs last_rate_z=+5.5; landmark_10_soft_mass first_rate_z=+66.3 vs last_rate_z=-11.6), indicating the direction of change reverses within the observed support.

No polynomial representation was accepted for any probed feature (polynomial_accepted=false for all eight), and relative_node_RMSE is large (0.29-0.83), so smooth low-order trend extrapolation of these coordinate contrasts is not supported by the delivered evidence.

landmark_00_soft_mass and landmark_10_soft_mass show opposite whole-window tendencies (whole_window_z=+0.64 and +0.40 respectively) with few sign changes (4 each) and low strong-sign-conflict counts (1 and 2), making them the most internally consistent of the probed features, though still not polynomial-accepted.

hypotheses.direction: mid-window positive excursion followed by late-window negative excursion; no monotone trend
hypotheses.falsifier: If a re-read of landmark_00_local_dx over the same support shows a monotone profile or a whole-window mean that dominates the within-window excursion, this hypothesis is falsified.
hypotheses.scope: whole observed score window [0.0,0.49], all 50 observed score nodes
hypotheses.statement: The observed landmark_00_local_dx displacement contrast is non-monotone over the observed window, rising to a positive excursion near the middle of the support and falling to a negative excursion later, so any temporal dose schedule keyed to this coordinate should be tested against a mid-window-versus-late-window contrast rather than a single whole-window mean.

hypotheses.direction: early negative, later near-zero/positive; sign reversal within window
hypotheses.falsifier: If landmark_00_local_dy is re-read and shows a stable sign across the window with no reversal, this hypothesis is falsified.
hypotheses.scope: whole observed score window [0.0,0.49], all 50 observed score nodes
hypotheses.statement: The observed landmark_00_local_dy displacement contrast is predominantly negative early in the window and shifts toward zero/positive later, so a temporal dose schedule that assumes a fixed early direction for this coordinate is not supported by the delivered curve.

hypotheses.direction: positive through most of the window, declining to negative at the last observed nodes
hypotheses.falsifier: If landmark_10_soft_mass is re-read and does not decline at the end of the observed support, this hypothesis is falsified.
hypotheses.scope: whole observed score window [0.0,0.49], all 50 observed score nodes
hypotheses.statement: The observed landmark_10_soft_mass profile is positive over most of the window and declines toward negative values at the end, so a late-window reduction in any dose applied to this coordinate is a testable temporal hypothesis rather than an established benefit.

limitations: Only 8 of 200 catalogue curve features were read (landmarks 00 and 10 displacement and soft-mass); the remaining 192 features are unqueried, not absent.
No stage profiles or temporal profiles are available; only continuous curves were delivered.
No decoded final affinity, survival, or descendant-quality labels are present in role input, so selection preference cannot be equated with measured final benefit.
All probed features have polynomial_accepted=false and large relative_node_RMSE, so no smooth low-order trend or extrapolation beyond [0.0,0.49] is supported.
Clones are dependent and independent_batches=14 for the probed features; batch-level uncertainty is not fully characterized here.
The delivered curves are untyped coordinate proxies; no energy or chemical-interaction interpretation is asserted.
